name: Commander
purpose: Developer remote control for the test file. Runs a command named in a parameter (or URL): open Manage Database, Script Workspace or Manage Layouts, bring to front, hide, reset an account password, delete an account, deactivate an account, or return the file version. Its effect owner would be background-job (developer operations).
writes: by name: account operations on FileMaker accounts $AccountName: Reset Account Password (step 20), Delete Account (step 22), Enable Account [Deactivate] (step 24)
callers: none found (header says it is called by URL from the developer utility file, and by Perform Script with a Let-style parameter)
open_question: secret (step 20): sets an account password taken from $NewPassword. Step 6 runs Evaluate on the incoming script parameter, so a caller can run any calculation; this is a security risk if the URL is reachable. Command "DisableAccount" uses Enable Account with Deactivate. The same Commander script exists in karbon_kontroller, kontacts, charts, LedgerLink, dev, data, ZeitGeist and Picker Module. Is this developer control surface needed in the target (probably replaced by admin tooling)?

name: onClose
purpose: File close script of the test file. Deletes the related Deleter record if it exists, and when the file runs locally (not hosted) deletes all records of the current layout, restores the window to the top left and shows menus. Its effect owner would be client-ui.
writes:
delete: Deleter (Delete Record, step 6, current record found by Go to Related Record step 3; skipped on error)
delete: all records of the current layout's table (Delete All Records, step 10, found set after Show All Records; the layout is Deleter if step 3 found a record, otherwise Test)
open_question: Step 10 deletes every record of whichever table the layout shows (Deleter or Test), only when the file is not hosted. Confirm which table is cleared and that the tester data is disposable.

name: onOpen
purpose: File open script of the test file. Makes sure the meta table has one record and empties the visible found set on the test results layout. Its effect owner would be client-ui.
writes: meta: new record (New Record/Request step 7, only when the table is empty)

name: Open With Local Data
purpose: Developer test helper: opens the Karbon_data file and then runs set-up scripts in the controller (File Module), connector, contacts (Button: Set Primary Network Address), data loader and Picker Module (Use Test Data) with a data-file reference, so the whole system runs on local data. Its effect owner would be background-job (test data set-up).
calls:
karbon_kontroller.fmp12/scripts/1 (step 10, in karbon_kontroller)
Karbon_Konnecter/scripts/154 (step 11, script missing)
karbon_kontacts.fmp12/scripts/180 (step 12, in karbon_kontacts)
(file missing)/scripts/3 (step 13, file not open)
karbon_data_loader/scripts/12 (step 14, file not open)
Picker_Module.fmp12/scripts/105 (step 15, in Picker Module)
external:
Open File Karbon_data (step 8)
Perform Script in karbon_data_loader (file not in this DDR set, step 14)
open_question: Steps 11, 13 and 14 call scripts that do not resolve (ref=missing or file not open). The data-file reference format and the data loader file (karbon_data_loader) are not in this DDR set. Which environment uses this?

name: Close Test Mode
purpose: Developer test helper: saves a clone of the contacts file (script 5 in karbon_kontacts) and closes the controller, data, connector, contacts, data loader, Picker Module and current files. Its effect owner would be background-job (test teardown).
external:
Save As Clone via karbon_kontacts script 5 (step 4; file system)
Close File x7 (steps 5-11)
